title: B8.4 mentor reference grade (PROVISIONAL TEMPLATE)
description: A mentor's grade for one submission on its rubric (PRD B8: reference grades from at least one mentor). No file of this type exists yet: the mentor or mentors are not named (design Q13). Score granularity (whole numbers, Q25) and the band used for agreement (Q44) are open, so scores are plain non-negative numbers here.

mentor_ref.description: Pseudonymous reference; the mapping to a real mentor is kept outside the repository.

blind_to_drafts.description: Whether the mentor graded before seeing any AI draft (design §11.3 proposal).
